gloss: faculty of education; school of education

definitions.gloss: faculty of education; school of education
definitions.explanation: The university division that studies education and trains teachers.

examples.japanese: {教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying in the faculty of education.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧になった。
examples.english: He graduated from the faculty of education and became a teacher.

examples.japanese: {教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{教員免許|きょういんめんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: In the faculty of education you study courses for earning a teaching license.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education) + {学部|がくぶ} (faculty). Most graduates pursue a teaching license, though the faculty also covers educational research.
